security_audit.summary: The static command, network, filesystem, and reconnaissance findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, Azure resource identifiers, and reference links. remediation.issue: Hardcoded database passwords appear in sample code.
remediation.suggestion: Replace literal passwords with placeholders that clearly require secure secret loading, such as Key Vault or environment-based configuration.

remediation.issue: Firewall examples include an Azure services allow rule.
remediation.suggestion: Add a warning about broad Azure service access and show private endpoint or narrow CIDR examples first.

content.value_statement: Azure MySQL administration often requires several SDK types and resource relationships. This skill gives focused .NET examples for common Flexible Server tasks.
actual_capabilities: Shows package installation for Azure.ResourceManager.MySql and Azure.Identity.
Explains the Azure MySQL Flexible Server resource hierarchy.
Provides C# examples for creating servers, databases, and firewall rules.
Covers configuration updates, Entra ID administrator setup, backup listing, and restore flows.
Lists key SDK types, SKU tiers, high availability modes, and related SDKs.
limitations: It is reference guidance, not an executable deployment tool.
Examples require valid Azure credentials, subscription access, and resource group names.
Users must adapt firewall, identity, backup, and SKU settings to their environment.
The examples do not replace Azure security review or production change control.

use_cases.title: Create Flexible Server resources
use_cases.description: Generate or review .NET code that creates an Azure MySQL Flexible Server with storage, backup, and high availability settings.

use_cases.title: Manage database operations
use_cases.description: Find SDK patterns for creating databases, listing resources, updating server parameters, and handling Azure SDK errors.

use_cases.title: Plan secure administration
use_cases.description: Use examples for Entra ID administrators, token-based connections, firewall rules, backups, and point-in-time restore planning.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic server
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me a simple .NET example that creates an Azure MySQL Flexible Server using Azure.ResourceManager.MySql.

prompt_templates.title: Add database and firewall rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add a database and a narrow firewall rule to an existing Azure MySQL Flexible Server in C#.

prompt_templates.title: Tune server configuration
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft .NET code to update MySQL Flexible Server configuration values and explain which settings need production review.

prompt_templates.title: Design restore workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Azure SDK for .NET workflow for listing backups and performing a point-in-time restore with safe validation steps.

output_examples.input: I need to create a MySQL Flexible Server for a production app.
output: Recommended SDK packages and authentication approach.
Server creation steps with storage, backup, and high availability choices.
Security notes for credentials, network access, and Entra ID administration.

output_examples.input: I need to inspect and tune server parameters.
output: The relevant configuration collection and resource types.
A sequence for reading current values before updating them.
Operational cautions for connection limits, slow query logging, and rollback planning.

output_examples.input: I need a restore plan after an incident.
output: Steps to list available backups and choose a restore point.
Guidance for creating a restored server instead of overwriting production.
Validation tasks for connectivity, data freshness, and access controls.

best_practices: Use DefaultAzureCredential and Entra ID where possible instead of embedded passwords.
Prefer private endpoints or narrow CIDR firewall rules for production workloads.
Review backup retention, high availability, and SKU choices before deployment.
anti_patterns: Do not copy sample administrator passwords into source code or configuration files.
Do not use broad firewall rules without a documented security exception.
Do not delete or restart production servers without change approval and backups.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy Azure resources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples that users can adapt and run in their own Azure environment.

faq.question: Which Azure service does it focus on?
faq.answer: It focuses on Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server using the Azure.ResourceManager.MySql .NET package.

faq.question: Can it help with authentication?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows DefaultAzureCredential usage and includes Entra ID administrator and token-based connection patterns.

faq.question: Does it cover backups and restore?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples for listing backups and creating a point-in-time restored server.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production code as written?
faq.answer: No. Users must replace placeholders, secure secrets, validate firewall rules, and review operational settings.

faq.question: Can it be used with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
